note: 17 targets found and ranked; my roster (1-0, all 10 starters filled, 5/5 bench full, no IR stash) has no empty slot and no acute hole, so this cycle is genuinely thin on PURSUEs. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is the one real move, a cheap hedge on my own Tuten in a Jaguars backfield that split 28-23 snaps in Week 1. Carson Wentz is AVOID here, not PURSUE: league-profile.md section 7 states 'no backup QB/TE, ever,' and Mahomes needs no QB2 insurance at $2-6 when that FAAB is better saved for a real injury-replacement frenzy.

targets.hook: Hedges Tuten: near-even Jax RB2 snap split, 28-23 Wk1
targets.why: Jacksonville's OC described Tuten and Rodriguez as a '1A/1B' combo building into Week 1 (Yahoo Sports, 2026-09-12), and the game backed it up: Tuten outsnapped Rodriguez only 28-23 (49% to 40%) and out-touched him 16-6 in a blowout win that shut down volume in garbage time (Underdog NFL snap-count tracker, X, 2026-09-14). Rodriguez ran fewer routes than Tuten but played more downs in heavier, play-action-leaning packages, per SI's Jaguars beat coverage.
targets.asset: 6 carries, 23 yards, 40% offensive snaps Week 1; the passing-down/heavy-package complement to Tuten rather than a change-of-pace afterthought
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 1, first data point of the season)
targets.my_team_impact: Tuten is my starting FLEX. A near-even snap split this close is a real threat to his role, not noise, and league-profile.md's doctrine explicitly sanctions one handcuff to a rostered RB's own backfield. This does not start over Tuten; it insures the slot he currently occupies.
targets.confidence_why: One game is too small a sample to call the split settled (LeQuint Allen was also questionable and barely played), so this is a stability question the roster doctrine caps to low even though the role itself looks real.
targets.competition: No rival roster shows a Jaguars-backfield need in this week's event feed or transaction log; this should clear at the routine-uncontested price.
targets.bid: 3 dollars, the top of the routine-uncontested band; nobody else in this league is chasing a Jax committee back this cheaply.
targets.drop: Quentin Johnston has produced nothing behind the Chargers' other options and is my least-used bench WR; not a name StoneBone69 or anyone else is watching, so it's a safe cut.
